newsitem.title: USA: Fleet Financial to exchange securities.
newsitem.headline: Fleet Financial to exchange securities.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group said on Monday that it is offering to exchange newly established 8.00 percent Trust Originated Preferred Securities (TOPrS) for any and all of the 11 million outstanding depositary shares of Fleet Financial Group Series V Preferred Stock.
Under the exchange offer, holders of Fleet Financial Group Series V depositary shares will receive one TOPrS in exchange for one Series V depositary share.
Each Series V depositary share represents 1/10 of a share of Series V 7.25 percent perpetual preferred stock.
The exchange offer expires January 30, 1997 unless extended.
